JSBSim-derived implementation and model provenance
===================================================

Source: JSBSim-Team/jsbsim, tag v1.3.3.
The imported JsbExact Lean implementation follows the classes named below.
These are upstream attributions, not claims that the Lean port is unmodified.
The port and generated model data are modifications dated 2026-11-01 in this
TV snapshot; original import revision is recorded in README.txt.

The upstream library source headers permit LGPL version 2 or any later
version; the upstream COPYING file supplies LGPL 2.1. The full LGPL 2.1 text
is included at ../../../LICENSES/LGPL-2.1.txt. Preserve these notices and the
applicable LGPL terms for derivative implementation code. No warranty.

Aircraft model data is a distinct provenance item:
https://github.com/JSBSim-Team/jsbsim/blob/v1.3.3/aircraft/c172p/c172p.xml
Its header identifies the author as Unknown and describes educational and
entertainment use based on public data, reports, textbooks, and estimates.
Its explicit restriction is:
"This simulation model is not endorsed by the manufacturer. This model is not
to be sold."

That notice applies to the source of JsbExact/C172Gen.lean. This free source
release preserves it; do not assume unrestricted commercial/model resale
rights from the library LGPL or the City Flight author permission. Obtain
clarification before selling the model or a product incorporating it.

This notice records the identified upstream classes; it is not an exhaustive
file-by-file derivation or legal analysis of every line of the imported port.
